integrity: The classification is proved analytically from rank/order-statistic independence and a likelihood-ratio comparison for the running maximum. The displayed Laplace-transform formulas are exact algebraic cross-checks; no finite enumeration or numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to independent one-dimensional exponential scale families and strict upper records. The adjacent covariance sign law assumes an equal-scale history before the tested time. No claim is made for arbitrary heterogeneous continuous laws, multivariate records, dependent observations, or the sign under a fully heterogeneous history. An equivalent finite-prefix statement could exist in older record literature under different notation.
title: Finite-prefix independence classification for heterogeneous exponential records
